name: context-keeper-remote
description: Remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers exposing context-keeper's rationale store over Streamable HTTP.

contextKeeper.//: Public deploy URL, used by scripts/set-view-token.* to build the view link. No wrangler command reports the workers.dev host -- not whoami, deployments list, versions list, or deployments status -- so it has to be written down somewhere. It is not a secret (it is in the README), and it is only ever half of a credential: the token is the other half. Self-hosters: change this to your own subdomain after deploying.
